title: The norm of sin x in L²[−π, π]
caption: ‖sin x‖² is the area under sin²x from −π to π. The curve oscillates between 0 and 1 with average ½, so the area is ½ × 2π = π and the norm is √π ≈ 1.772.
alt: The curve y = sin squared x between −π and π, two humps of height 1 touching zero at −π, 0 and π, shaded underneath.
description: The norm squared is ∫ sin²x dx over [−π, π].
sin²x = (1 − cos 2x)/2 averages ½ over a whole number of periods.
The area is ½ × 2π = π, so ‖sin x‖ = √π ≈ 1.772.

checks.name: the area under sin²x on [−π, π] is π
